title: Handover block
description: Shared block every Hektor subagent return must carry. Tells the orchestrator who ran, how it ended, and what happens next.

role.description: The dispatch role-prefix this subagent ran as, e.g. composer-j-map-search.

next-action.description: What the orchestrator should do next, e.g. 'dispatch workflow-reviewer-pass-1'.
